correctness.rationale: For a club D, each basic initial segment [0,beta] has inverse image under pi_D either empty or [0,max(D intersection [0,beta])], so the retraction is continuous. As pi_D(alpha)>=alpha the pullback preserves C_0, and it is contractive and idempotent. A proper club has a gap [xi,eta) as stated. The singleton {xi} is clopen since xi is 0 or a successor, and [xi+1,eta]=(xi,eta+1) is clopen and compact. The proposed difference of their indicators is continuous, compactly supported and has norm one. At xi the complement takes value 1-(-1)=2; the operator triangle inequality gives the exact bound. The full-club case is the zero complement. Inspected VERIFICATION.md; no numerical certificate is required. The published facts are real but the frozen article's reference numbers are wrong for arXiv v1 and the inspected later PDF: use Lemma 2.12(ii),(iv),(v) and Corollary 1.7 and its proof, not Lemma 2.14(v) and the proof of Corollary 1.9. This does not invalidate the mathematical assertion.
